<translate>
'''Demon Realm Villagers''' are the residents of the demon villages of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]], dressed in Demon Realm outfits. About '''40%''' of them are '''bug traders''' who sell Medi-Bugs.
</translate>

<translate>
== Where to find them ==

Demon villages generate on the Third Demon World: a plaza surrounded by 3–5 adobe houses, 1–2 farms, adobe-brick paths and lantern posts. Each house has 1–2 villagers. Every village also has a [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]] on its plaza.
</translate>

<translate>
== Medi-Bug trades ==

A bug trader sells 2–3 of these offers for emeralds. The other villagers don't trade.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Item</translate> !! <translate>Effect when eaten</translate> !! <translate>Cost</translate> !! <translate>Uses</translate>
|-
| <translate>Medi-Bug (Ant)</translate> || <translate>Restores 85% of your health, ki and stamina. It has its own cooldown, as long as the Senzu Bean's.</translate> || <translate>8 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate>Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate> || <translate>Right-click to split it into two identical Medi-Bug (Beetle). Two players who eat beetles with the same ID within 30 seconds fuse.</translate> || <translate>16 Emeralds</translate> || 2
|-
| <translate>Medi-Bug (Rhino)</translate> || <translate>Medi-Bug Shell for 45 seconds: you take 30% less damage.</translate> || <translate>6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate>Medi-Bug (Worm)</translate> || <translate>Mastery Gain II for 5 minutes: 50% more form mastery.</translate> || <translate>6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|}

<translate>
Trades restock once per in-game day when you trade with the villager. The beetle fusion is explained on [[Special:MyLanguage/Medi-Bug Beetles|Medi-Bug Beetles]]. Besides the bug traders, Bulma's repeatable '''Medi-Bug Market''' sidequest sells a batch of Medi-Bugs (a Beetle pair included) for emeralds and gold ingots, once an hour.
</translate>

{{Note|type=warning|title=<translate>Alignment</translate>|<translate>Killing a Demon Realm Villager or the Time Patroller lowers your alignment.</translate>}}
